title: centaurea phrygia subsp. alutacea
intro: Centaurea phrygia subsp. alutacea, commonly known as a species of thistle, is a flowering plant that belongs to the family Asteraceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, helping to soothe skin irritations, wounds, and other conditions. The therapeutic actions of Centaurea phrygia subsp. alutacea include its ability to reduce inflammation, fight infection, and protect against cell damage, making it a promising natural remedy for various health issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
